articles.author: Robbie Griffiths
articles.title: Europe heat wave fuels drought, fires and energy fears - NPR
articles.description: Europe's heat wave exposes buried history and new threats — Nazi-era wrecks emerge from the Danube, nuclear reactors face cooling risks, and Greece battles deadly wildfires.
articles.content:
LONDON As Europe endures a relentless heat wave, the Danube's historic lows are disrupting nuclear power operations and revealing the far-reaching impacts of the continent's climate crisis.
